title: Classical limit of the electromagnetic coupling
html:
Remark. Classical limit of the electromagnetic coupling

Remark (classical limit). As q \to 1, [n]_q \to n and \alpha_{\mathrm{EM}} \to 1/90. The observed value \alpha^{-1} \approx 137 requires q > 1. The departure from the classical limit makes the coupling weaker than 1/90.

Remark (physical interpretation). The descent decomposition of the coupling mirrors the mass decomposition (see Table 2). The correction is positive. The force-carrier braids T_{2,9} and T_{3,5} embed on the genus-4 Bring's surface. They possess crossing degeneracies that screen the bare electromagnetic charge. This increases 1/\alpha from the bare value.
